use: The rack. One die, its label typeset on the band.
subject: An office rubber stamp standing upright, seen from slightly above and in front, photographed against a plain flat pure white background with nothing else in the picture. A turned wooden knob, a slender shaft, and a wider wooden base with the rubber die beneath it. Around the shaft is a plain paper band, completely blank. The wood is worn and darkened by handling and the rubber edge is stained with old violet ink.
